name: Kokusai-dori & Makishi Public Market
nameJa: 国際通り・第一牧志公設市場

en.name: Kokusai-dori & Makishi Public Market
en.description: Naha's famous 'Miracle Mile' vibrant avenue lined with Okinawan souvenir shops, awamori distilleries, steak houses, and fresh tropical seafood dining upstairs at Makishi Market.
highlights: Buy Okinawan souvenirs, Chatan salt, and purple yam sweets
Select fresh local fish at Makishi Market and have it cooked upstairs
Enjoy live Okinawan sanshin music performance at local izakayas
en.reservationInfo: No reservation needed for street walk; market restaurants may have wait times at noon.
en.parkingInfo: Paid coin parking lots behind main street.

ja.name: 国際通り・第一牧志公設市場
ja.description: 「奇跡の1マイル」と称される那覇最大の繁華街。お土産屋やステーキハウス、鮮魚が並ぶ公設市場の2階食堂で沖縄グルメを満喫。
highlights: 沖縄銘菓ちんすこうや紫芋スイーツ、泡盛のショッピング
第一牧志公設市場で買った鮮魚を2階食堂で調理してもらう「持ち上げ」体験
夜は三線ライブ居酒屋で賑やかな民謡とオリオンビール
ja.reservationInfo: 通り散策は自由。人気食堂はランチ帯に混雑あり。
ja.parkingInfo: 周辺裏通りにコインパーキング多数。

highlights: Naha's main shopping and entertainment street
Local Okinawan cuisine and souvenir shops
notes: Naha's main shopping street — great for Okinawan souvenirs and street food.
